generator_metadata.summary: Rotate source-local 8/9 markers a quarter-turn into a second local frame.

review_brief:
# Review: 91ba253f9945

Task/source: `91ba253f9945`, generator `2.0.0`, canonical rule hash `b1e5584ad797`.
Defect: the selected generator produced unrelated color-9-separated panels; it never generated the canonical 2/3/4 and 5/6/7 coordinate frames.
Repair: replaced it with a checked local-frame sampler and added a native matched-input `turn={counterclockwise,clockwise}` family; the default program is exact canonical source.
Teaching/export: supports 2–6 demonstrations, a stable four-query bank, one-at-a-time shuffled public views, and substantive 11x15 through 30x30 queries.
Adversarial repairs: changed global-only rival aggregation to episode-level demo-fit/query-change checks, then removed a six-motif/query-reuse leak found during final review.
Final bounded audit: 36 episodes, 396 episode/rival checks, 11 task-specific rivals including the old six-motif lookup, 60/60 unique retained motifs, and no surviving or ambiguous shortcut.
Sampler audit: 256 ordinary base draws plus 320 parametric episodes / 2,560 claimed pairs, with 320/320 distinct seed-level marker motifs and 64 single-query stability checks.
Protected Racket: authoring preflight passed both settings, four jobs, 24 parametric pairs, three canonical pairs, and 32 evaluations.
Causal witness: protected replay proves that replacing source-frame projection with raw grid deltas changes the final output.
Sequential projection: 16 views verified; four first turns passed 24 private/future-query invariance mutations and four visible-change controls.
Status: reviewer-ready only. Owner source review, native qualification/acceptance, and training admission remain pending/false.
Limits: finite seeds and named rivals do not prove uniqueness against arbitrary programs or downstream learning gain.

sequential_dependency.intermediate: An input-dependent ordered list of source-local marker coordinates and colors; for this case the protected output depends on the source basis rather than raw row/column deltas.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Find the 2/3/4 source frame, project every nearby 8/9 marker into that frame, sort the resulting (u,v,color) list, and apply the episode-fixed quarter-turn to those local coordinates.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Use the 5/6/7 target frame to map each turned local coordinate back to a grid cell and paint its retained marker color.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Step B receives only the local marker list produced by Step A. Replacing source-frame projection with raw grid deltas changes that list and therefore changes the protected final grid on the same qualified input.

parametric_work.summary: Exact canonical counterclockwise default plus clockwise alternative on matched inputs; 2-6 demonstrations, four private queries, fresh nonreused marker motifs, substantive 30x30 stress, episode-level shortcut rejection including the former six-motif lookup, protected-Racket authoring preflight, causal witness, and privacy-checked sequential projection.

target_report.summary: Replaced the unrelated panel generator with the canonical local-frame domain and built a source-bound clockwise/counterclockwise native family with fresh per-pair motifs, deep adversarial regression tooling, protected-Racket, causal, and sequential-export evidence.
